conflicts.resolution: Preserve commits, tests and evidence; supersede only its acceptance question; close the PR after the WP0 court-record merge; never merge it as v0.2 acceptance.

rollback: Revert the WP0 squash merge with a new non-destructive commit if the materialisation record is incorrect. Do not delete v0.1 evidence, rewrite Git history, remove chart dependencies, or expose real sources.
